definition: A heterogeneous and rare group of Mendelian ciliopathy disorders characterized by developmental abnormalities of the oral cavity, face, and digits caused by dysfunction of the primary cilium.

source.title: Expanding the genetic landscape of oral‐facial‐digital syndrome with two novel genes
source.quote: Oral-facial-digital syndromes (OFDS) are a heterogeneous and rare group of Mendelian disorders characterized by developmental abnormalities of the oral cavity, face, and digits caused by dysfunction of the primary cilium, a mechanosensory organelle that exists atop most cell types that facilitates organ patterning and growth.
